What I did

The JWT secret fell to offline cracking in seconds, which allowed forging an admin token. NoSQL injection on login bypassed authentication entirely.

Also covered object-level and function-level authorization flaws, mass assignment, and SSRF used to probe internal services.

Results

A weak JWT secret can be cracked offline to forge an admin token, and URL parameters without an allowlist open SSRF.

Log signal: login body with {"$ne": null}; fetch-avatar request to 169.254.169.254

Next

Use a high-entropy JWT secret, sanitize NoSQL input and apply an egress allowlist.

Withheld on purpose: credentials , flags and lab IPs .
